# Third-party code

`gmp-wasm-1.3.2.umd.min.js` is [gmp-wasm](https://github.com/Daninet/gmp-wasm) v1.3.2 by Dani Biro, an unmodified
copy of `dist/index.umd.min.js` from the [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gmp-wasm/v/1.3.2). It contains
[GMP](https://gmplib.org/) and [MPFR](https://www.mpfr.org/) compiled to WebAssembly.

It is licensed under the **GNU LGPL v3** ([LICENSE.LGPL-3.0.txt](LICENSE.LGPL-3.0.txt), which builds on the
[GNU GPL v3](LICENSE.GPL-3.0.txt)), not under this repository's Unlicense. Its source code is at
https://github.com/Daninet/gmp-wasm/tree/v1.3.2.
